text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—I still remember the Marvelous
from the day of my first race! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Kids' Race Organizer
text_block_list.text: Huh, you want to jump in and join—!?

text_block_list.name: Young Marvelous
text_block_list.text:
That's right☆
Now that I can finally run★
I wanna run with everyone, too☆★

text_block_list.name: Kids' Race Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But we're up against older girls,
so we might not be able to win, you know?

text_block_list.name: Young Marvelous
text_block_list.text:
I don't care☆ I just wanna run★
'Cause I've got a Marvelous hunch☆
So pleeease!★☆

text_block_list.name: Kids' Race Organizer
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Well, if you insist that much...

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, you're running with a kid that small?
Isn't that dangerous?

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
They said she's only a year younger than me.
Mom said she's so small 'cause she was in the hospital until recently.

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's pretty weird.
It's just a festival race,
so why do they want to run so badly—?

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, whoa, that girl is fas—!

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Are you kidding me?!
Losing after all that is just--d-damn it all~!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
GOOOOAL!!
A staggering 10 horse lengths ahead of the pack—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: The winner of this year's Little Umamusume Race is the girl with the red ribbon—Marvelous Sunday!!!

text_block_list.name: Young Marvelous
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha, MARVELOUUUS☆★

text_block_list.name: Young Marvelous
text_block_list.text:
Running is so much fun, isn't it☆
It was super-duper marvelous★☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Aha... She really looks like she's having fun
just being able to run.
Plus, she's crazy fast too~!

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Because she was giving it her all from the very start.
I couldn't win because I wasn't taking it seriously...

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
—That settles it!
Starting tomorrow, I'm taking running seriously!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "I got so, so many cheers from everyone that day! ☆★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The older girls smiled at the end and
promised we'd race again ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
After the race, everyone was truly MARVELOUS☆
That's why I became certain★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Racing is the most marvelous way
to bring MARVELOUS to the world☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My days of challenging the Twinkle Series
together with Marvelous Sunday have begun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today, I asked some close friends to join me for a joint training session, but—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha☆ Ahahaha★
Ahahahahahaha☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelouuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Running really is marvelous☆★
Hey, hey, Trainer! Can I do one more lap!?
—Wait, wait, Mave-chin!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haa—haa—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, right on the clock!
As expected of Maya, nice landi~ng♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —No, wait!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
This is tempo running, so no pulling ahead~!
For formation flying, staying in formation is everything, right?☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right!
Right now, focusing on form is probably more important than speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Poor posture leads to injuries—
so let's check it properly, you two♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning to the starting gate behind
Marvelous Sunday were two other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to debut in the same generation as Marvelous Sunday
is Mayano Top Gun, a naturally gifted girl
blessed with astonishing intuition, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel possesses an inner strength undeterred
by her inherently weak legs, combined with
a cheerful, positive outlook.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Sooorry☆ Mayano, Laurel★
I just couldn't help myself—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I mean, just look at that cloud! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: It's super, duuuper Marvelous, right? ☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Listen, listen! 4.6 billion years ago when Earth was born, there wasn't any water on this planet☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
But then, against astronomical odds, a miracle happened! ☆
After hundreds of millions of years, it rained for the very first time! ★
And from that, the ocean was born! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And then again and again—again and again!☆★
The sea became clouds, the clouds became rain, and turned right back into those clouds!☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Changing again in an instant,
that cloud is a cloud that only exists right here, right now☆ Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The same goes for us Umamusume☆
The me of right now only exists right now★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Then I just have to show my present self with everything I've got☆
Because that's connected to sharing the Marvelous with the whole world too★☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Miracles—happiness—wonderful everyday surprises.
The concept of "Marvelous" encompasses all positive sensations in the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her dream is to spread this concept of "Marvelous"
to the world through racing.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, no, no, no!
Even Trainer's being fooled!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aren't we in the middle of training right now~?
No matter how much you want to run, sneaking off is forbidden! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I think I agree with Maya-chan♪
I want both of them to have a safe debut
without doing anything reckless in training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "I still can't put too much strain on my legs yet, so big races are out of reach for now, but—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I believe that someday, I'll even be able
to run in a GⅠ race together with
Mabe-chan and Maya-chan!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Laurel~~! Of course I believe in you too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! Fuji Kiseki-senpai is here!
Is she about to start training!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Over there are Narita Brian-senpai and
Hishi Amazon-senpai! What incredible presence!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ââHaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Kyaaaaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Members
text_block_list.text:
Lady Fuji~ you're so gorgeous~~!!
I can't wait for your debut~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: *pant*—*pant*—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, one more lap, Brian!
âDon't tell me you're worn out already?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Naturally. Let's go, Ama-san!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah, Fuji and the others are sparkling☆
It's super marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday turned her gaze toward
the Umamusume who would soon stand before her
as formidable rivals—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki, who gathered the most attention among those debuting in the same class and aimed for emotionally moving races as an entertainer herself, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With an overwhelming racing style that had people whispering a "Triple Crown" was well within reach, the "Monster" of the older generation, Narita Brian—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And known as the 'Empress' for her ferocious
late charge and legs that leave everyone in the dust:
Hishi Amazon."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If we run in the Twinkle Series,
I'm sure we can become marvelous just like that too☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: “You're right. Right now, I can't even stand side-by-side with them, but someday—”

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Because once Maya debuts,
I'm gonna be the most sparkling, mature Umamusume ever☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And so—excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahhh!! It's tag time☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, ahahahahaha☆★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After finishing a fulfilling joint training session, I went up to the rooftop with Marvelous Sunday—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: It was sooooo marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Because Mayano, Laurel, Fuji, Brian, and Hishiama—everyone was shining so bright chasing their dreams!☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: You see, everyone was shining so brightly because they truly believe in their own marvelousness☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Believing in yourself, that you can totally make your dreams come true☆
That very feeling is what's Marvelous★"
choice_data_list: You believe it too, don't you?
You believe it too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Of course☆ Marvelous things come to those who believe★
As long as you keep your eyes on the marvelous, unbelievable strength will well up inside you☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"That's why the world needs to notice the Marvelous more☆
Not believing just because you can't see it...
That's suuuch a huge waste★"
choice_data_list: Let's show 'em what we've got in the Twinkle Series!
Let's show them what we can do in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yup☆ If I keep showing everyone marvelousness,
I'm sure they'll realize their own marvelousness too★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that said, Marvelous Sunday runs to the edge of the rooftop overlooking the track. And then—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Everyooone, listen up!! I'm gonna
bring the Marvelous straight to all of you!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's why I made it! ☆
Namely, the "World Marvelous Project"! ★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Number one☆
Train lots and lots to get a marvelous and strong stride!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Step two☆
Use that running style to enter bigger and bigger races!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Step 3☆
Spread the Marvelous so every~one is happy★☆★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the sound of Marvelous Sunday's loud voice,
several students heading home looked up at the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So don't blink, okay? ☆
This is where Project Marvelous the World begins! ★
